source_note: Sourced 2026-10-18: thewowdb.com (this project's preferred direct-extraction source) was still down, so talent names/tiers/ranks/prerequisites/per-rank text were extracted from a real headless-Chrome render of talentsforever.com's talent-list and interactive-calculator pages (grid-area row/column attributes, aria-label rank text, verbatim per-rank tooltip text), not an AI-summarized fetch -- the same lesson this project applied after an earlier Wowhead extraction failure. Confidence: community-reported (third-party compiled/interpreted, not this project's own direct client-file read). Icon coverage: 28/50 verified against a sitewide name->icon map built from all 9 classes' own 'recent changes' feeds (542 unique entries) plus an 'Improved X -> X's own icon' fallback heuristic, and (Warlock only) a per-talent Wowhead-tooltip-API id-verification pass (nether.wowhead.com/tooltip/spell/<id>?dataEnv=16, accepting only exact name matches). The remaining 22 use a placeholder icon (inv_misc_questionmark) and are flagged icon_verified: false rather than guessed.
